name: Diverse Swordlord Techniques (Combat)
body:
While you have attended a prestigious dueling school that focuses upon the dueling sword, you have learned to apply the techniques to other nimble blades.

Prerequisite(s): Exotic Weapon Proficiency (dueling sword).

Benefit(s): For any ability, feat, or trait that is restricted to the dueling sword, you may use any weapon from the light blades or heavy blades that may be used with Weapon Finesse. This includes qualifying for prerequisites. However, if you qualified for a feat that requires a feat that calls out the dueling sword, like Weapon Focus, you must meet that prerequisite with the substitute weapon, and it is only usable with that weapon. This does not extend to feats that select the dueling sword like Weapon Focus or Improved Critical.

Normal: There are many feats and class abilities that are only applicable when using a dueling sword.
